en.headline: Police announce special traffic plans for HZMB half marathon this weekend
en.dek: Lane closures on the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong section will begin Saturday afternoon, with temporary two-way running on part of the link road into Sunday.
body: Police said special traffic and transport arrangements will take effect from Saturday afternoon to facilitate the HZMB (Hong Kong Section) Half Marathon 2026, which runs on Sunday.

From 4 pm to about 11 pm on Saturday, the left and middle lanes of the Hong Kong-bound section of the HZMB Hong Kong Link Road between the Hong Kong Port and the boundary will be closed. Drivers heading to Hong Kong must use the right lane.

From about 11 pm Saturday to about 2 pm Sunday, all lanes of the Zhuhai and Macao-bound section will close, along with the middle lane of the Hong Kong-bound section and a spur road to the Lantau turnaround. Two-way traffic will operate on the original Hong Kong-bound carriageway during this period. A goods vehicle exit lane at the port will also close from about 9 pm Saturday to about 3 pm Sunday.

Additional Airport Express services will run early Sunday from Hong Kong Station to AsiaWorld-Expo to help participants reach the start area. The Transport Department and police advised motorists to plan journeys in advance and allow extra time.

zh.headline: 警方公布港珠澳大橋半馬周末特別交通安排
zh.dek: 港珠澳大橋香港連接路周六下午起分段封路，部分路段周日改行雙程雙線，駕駛者需預留時間。
body: 警方表示，為配合周日舉行的港珠澳大橋（香港段）半馬拉松2026，特別交通及運輸安排將由周六下午起實施。
周六下午4時至晚上約11時，港珠澳大橋香港連接路往香港方向介乎香港口岸與分界線之間路段的左線及中線封閉，前往香港的車輚須使用右線。
周六晚上約11時至周日下午約2時，往珠海及澳門方向全部行車線、往香港方向中線以及來往鐿石灣掉頭處支路封閉，原往香港方向路段實施雙線雙程行車。香港口岸貨車出境通道亦由周六晚上約9時至周日下午約3時臨時封閉。
港鐵機場快線周日清晨增設由香港站往博覽館站的特別班次，方便參賽者前往起點。運輸署及警方呼籲駕駛者及早規劃行程。
